It all started in the living room of Jo Horgan's Melbourne home, where she hatched a vision to search the world for the most exciting makeup, niche fragrances and cutting-edge skincare, bringing them home for Australians to enjoy. In 1997, the first MECCA Cosmetica store opened in South Yarra, offering an expertly curated selection of seven renowned global beauty brands, that weren’t previously available down under. By 2001, MECCA was leading the way with online shopping, enabling beauty enthusiasts to browse and buy their favourite products anytime, anywhere at our dot-com. Six years later, MECCA ventured across international waters to open its doors in Aotearoa (New Zealand).

We believe that beauty has the power to change lives. That's why in 2017, we launched our social change program, MECCA M-POWER , which aimed to assist 10,000 girls facing social and financial barriers to complete secondary school. Since achieving that goal in 2022, M-POWER now has a new mission: to create a world where women and girls can thrive and achieve their full potential – a world of possibility and opportunity, regardless of gender. Through M-POWER, we support a group of over 20 incredible organisations dedicated to creating a future where the next generation can thrive. We strive to fight for women by ensuring their access to education, improving their health, safety and well-being, empowering female-led businesses, supporting women to become financially secure and independent and elevating women's voices in politics and public life.

text:
I’ve had just excellent experiences in two Mecca stores now, and I felt compelled to share! On my recent visit to the Castle Hill / Castle Towers store, I was met by Elizabeth, a skin specialist. She took the time to listen to my skin concerns, explained my condition in detail, and provided expert advice on what’s best for my skin.

Her knowledge, kindness, and patience made the experience truly outstanding. Honestly, the level of customer service I’ve received—not just from Elizabeth, but from all the staff I’ve encountered—has been consistently wonderful. This is my second review for Mecca, and it’s well-deserved. 🙌

Had an amazing time here. Best recommendations and the service is the best you will ever get in a cosmetic beauty store. Big shout out to Mia. Such great service and she really knew her stuff about all the products and how to best use them.

Just coming back to my review from 6 month ago to update. I just came back from probably the best facial I ever had. Klaren was absolutely amazing and able to perfectly navigate my temperamental skin. I'm blown away by the consistent high quality service that receive every time I come here. Amazing
Everyone was so sweet and so helpful.
Natalie did my make up as part of the Beauty Loop Rewards and she was fantastic! She was patient, friendly and really listened to what I wanted!
Horrible service

PSA to anyone looking to get makeup tips or even just general advice around skincare and beauty, Sofia and Keira and all the girls at this store are absolutely incredible. Sofia was the most patient, kind and talented artist and Keira went the extra mile to make sure my appointment went as smoothly as possible! So grateful for the experience

12 August 2025  I had a beauty loop reward facial
with BERNIE . The facial i had was absolutely awesome.
my skin was so radiant and glowing so happy!!!
plus Bernie wrote down all the products she used.
very professional.Great customer service.
Castle Towers Mecca
Caitlin is amazing. Not only did she explained everything so nicely but was very patient and kind

I called this store prior to going in to make sure they had stock of what I needed as I was travelling from 60kms away. When I arrived at this store to pick up and pay, the box that they’d put on hold for me was EMPTY!  Yes, you’ve read that right, EMPTY!! Such absolute incompetence from this store. Stop wasting people’s time. You’ve now lost all my business.
Very happy with the service and products,
Every team member constantly ignores and acted like I did not exist when I was looking at things for ages. They are very rude compared to other stores. Just such a cold and awful experience.

I was served by the staff member Dee at the Parramatta store but her home store is Towers so writing the review here!
The store was insanely busy but Dee was so attentive, she walked through what I wanted and asked me about my current makeup routine and what wasn’t working. She shade matched me so quickly and offered products and strategies that would help the issues I was having.
The foundation I wanted to sample was almost out, and she even emptied it out with an eyelash spoolie to make sure I could take some home to try. She also got me a sample of a primer she thought would help without me even asking.
I rattled off so many questions to her and she was so kind and helpful answering everything with so much thought. She helped me out with bronzers too and recommended different types.
She didn’t pressure me to buy anything at all, made such nice conversation with me about my work and life and was just so gorgeous.
I’m actually so sad that I don’t live in the area because I’d love to be able to go back and update her on her recommendations and get more.
Asking for help can be so daunting and anxiety inducing, especially in a packed store, but Dee was so warm and so dedicated and so helpful. 5 stars to Dee! Thank you, thank you, thank you!

Went in on 07/04 and had an excellent experience getting foundation recommendations and shade matched! Big ups to Shaniqua, who was so lovely, knowledgeable, patient, and extremely helpful. I was apprehensive before entering as it felt daunting, but I'm very glad I did! This store is also a bit more spacious than some others, so that added to it being less overwhelming.

Ok. I knew it. I was sure but I should have had a little bit of trust, so I gave it a go. My husband bought me a very expensive perfume as a gift, nice gesture but he has been guaranteed that the receiver of the gift can return or exchange the perfume within 90 days. With gift receipt attached to the box.In less than a week I took the perfume to the shop in Castle Hill tower. The packaging, the original wraps, everything was there but to reveal what's inside you need to crack open the tiny little tape on the small paper box (not clear to see what's inside) the perfume is located in to show to the person who has bought you the gift that you care. I opened the box, the bottle's lead has already have extreem  discolouration ( its a pity I can not attach the photos)
I used the sample and I didn't liked the fragrance and I found the item too expensive so when I returned the item in addition to the little sample, I've been told that the item has been used!!! I showed the sample still have some perfume in it and the date as I couldn't even been able to use the item even if I wanted, but no.... they gave me a gift card to purchase other stuff.  Maybe more gifts for someone else who can not return it and....the cycle keeps going on and on. This is sad and disappointing.  I will contact fair trading NSW and will fight to get my money back but still wanted to share my aweful experience with others.

Louise at the check out was very unprofessional. Bad attitude and incapable. When I asked her if I can use alipay she replied no without even checking and rolled her eyes. I had to insist that she asked her manager and she finally learnt how to process the payment.
It was amazing

I have never walked into a Mecca Store before but had a gift I wished to purchase. I was lucky enough it was Tuesday and the store wasn’t buzzing with lots of people.
I was greeted by Emma…..I explained who I was buying for, my budget and what sort of things I had in mind. Just WOW she went over and beyond, she really knew all the products and showed me ‘exactly’ what I had in mind and explained everything so well. She listened and she nailed it. Emma was so lovely….her whole aura actually made the hair stand up on my arms. I actually hugged her and thanked her. What an easy, stress free and satisfying experience. Totally recommend this store……ask for Emma….she is terrific.

I had walked in to have my makeup touched up as I was having issues with my base makeup due to the hot weather & sweating almost everything off. I was attending a car event upstairs and had gone downstairs to Mecca as my makeup was almost in shambles.

I was having a really welcoming and friendly interaction with one of the workers (I honestly forgot her name but she was absolutely the sweetest)! She helped me touch up my makeup and even guided me on what products to use in case I had needed to come downstairs again to fix my makeup in case she wasn’t available 🥹

She’s super helpful and so nice to talk to - I just wanted to say a huge thank you to that artist and appreciate your help so much 🩷

I had a makeup application yesterday for a friend's wedding and just want to take a moment to shout out the incredible Sophia. I asked for quite an intricate and bold look and she was up for the challenge. She talked me through every step and all products she planned on using so I felt comfortable. She was very knowledgeable and wasn't afraid to share ideas and options. I'm usually very particular about my makeup but she just got me!!! I was so happy.

I think the best part was that I could tell that she was genuinely excited for the challenge and to try something different. It made the experience enjoyable and a lot of love went into the look 🥰

Highly recommend Sophia to anyone booking a makeup application at Mecca Castle Towers.

I also wanted to mention another store host that served me a few weeks ago (I think her name was Charlie??) from the Fragrance section. She's so knowledgeable and was very patient and helpful to navigate the sometimee overwhelming collection of fragrances. Thanks for being so wonderful.
Can’t recommend Mecca customer service enough their staff is always so helpful and friendly. They always make my experience better. :) Keep up the good work.
Jeyda was extremely kind and useful when colour matching my skin and helping us with product recommendations. The best customer service!
Great options and great staff, always willing to help.

I had a wonderful experience with Clarin today. She helped me find a gift for a friend who is into new and emerging TikTok trends.

Clarin went out of her way to suggest multiple things within my budget and ensured that my needs were met as well as the person I was buying for.

Clarin asked engaging and important questions such as different skin types or their favourite products at the moment.

I also had a great experience with Liv? or potentially Lib. Or maybe something completely different lol. She wrapped my gifts for me and was incredibly kind and helpful.

I had a positive experience in Mecca today and as someone who also works retail during christmas it is nice to be in a positive environment in what can be such a stressful experience for a lot of people.

I hope your team is rewarded for their positivity, and their kind and helpful nature.

Thank you :)

I have been getting regular facials
With Lyndal at mecca castle hill
She is fantastic!
I can not recommend her enough.
Her knowledge and attention to detail is unmatched.

I had the best experience this morning here. I needed a new foundation and the staff member was so helpful and lovely at making sure I found something that worked for my skin and was a really great shade match. She also was really really helpful in finding me a new lip product even though I am certain I kept using the wrong descriptors for what I wanted, but she was so patient and lovely and always had another suggestion. Really really great

I want to give a big thank you to Caitlin at Mecca Castle tower for her incredible help with my skincare needs. As a regular customer, I’ve often asked for recommendations, but Caitlin went above and beyond. She spent time with me, carefully explaining which products would work best for my skin concerns. Her recommendations were spot-on, and I could see a real difference when I tried them. I’ll definitely be purchasing those products! I hope Mecca recognizes the value of dedicated employees like Caitlin. Her expertise and care make all the difference!

Bianca was amazing! She really went above and beyond for me, and she was so lovely. She recommended products & provided detailed explanations/instructions for them. Thank you, Bianca for a great service!

I just wanted to pop on here and give my feedback of the store. In particular a sales consultant by the name of Nicola who assisted in the sale of Barbra Sturm skincare range.

I walked in looking for the Barbra strum skincare range “glow kit”. As this was my first time using her products I asked Nicola her opinion on product and textures. I was amazed at how informative and helpful she was. She even put some of the cleansers on her hand to show me the texture (i had already used up both mine doing just that)! I asked for 2 samples which would last me a week which she delightfully did. She filled two whole jars which would give me a little over a week if I really spread it out!

The samples she gave me were full to the brim which allowed me to get a full “test” of the product. Upon paying at the cashier she mentioned that I was a level 3 member and I had redeemed a perfume. She then proceeded to show me 3 options for me to choose from (I of course asked her suggestion at this stage as I have already loved her service). Before paying, I had smelt some baccarat perfumes but wasn’t interested at that stage to invest in perfumes as I was just chatting to friends and enjoying smelling them. I couldn’t believe she even put a sample of my perfume that I had mentioned I liked from baccarat in the samples bag!!!

I have been in the beauty industry and retail for over 15 years and it’s been so delightful to experience such great customer service.

Because of the amazing samples and her service I went into store about 3-4 days later to buy the product she had sampled me but as Nicola wasn’t working that day another lady (didn’t catch the name) served me. She was lovely also and I had asked to try the “eye cream” as I had sampled the serum previously and she had filled the sample jar half way even though I mentioned I wanted a weeks worth. I understand maybe policy not to fill the sample jars but just wanted to mention because Nicola had filled the sample jars I had walked into store only 3-4 days later to buy two products valued at $780.00.

Just wanted to say thanks to Nicola for making in store shopping so wonderful. Definitely an asset to the Mecca Brand

Omg I had the best time! The staff at Castle Towers are sooo lovely, and I couldn’t thank Devi enough for her wonderful service !!!
She is super kind, knowledgeable, patient and made me so comfortable the whole time! 💯💯💯✨

i got my formal make up done here yesterday as part of the glam makeup and it was literally the best experience ever. My make up artist was so sweet and did it so so so good. I also got my hair done by another really really nice person and it was so pretty. both the hair and makeup stayed looking amazing the whole entire night it (more than eight hours). the staff here are all so kind they cater to all your needs (hair, makeup, a dead phone 😭)
thanks for the amazing service!!!!
Tess - a wealth of knowledge and so helpful. Thank you!

I had such a wonderful experience with the staff here, namely Bianca. She was really sweet , patient and was incredibly helpful when choosing a variety of products as well as reccomending which ones would be most suitable for my skin. Highly recommend the store and thanks heaps to her.

I recently visited Castle Towers Mecca and was extremely disappointed with the customer service. The staff were dismissive, creating an environment that felt anything but welcoming. It’s crucial for businesses to treat their customers with respect, but instead, I felt ignored and undervalued. A positive atmosphere is essential for a good experience, and unfortunately, that was lacking during my visit. I hope they can make significant improvements in the future.

First time visiting Mecca today, and couldn’t be more happier with the level of customer service I received. I needed assistance with makeup matching, products and application. I was served by an incredibly kind, helpful, and patient assistant who helped me significantly understand my skin tone, what product was best for me and how to apply. I truly valued the help she provided me, my only regret is not grabbing her name! I hope she is identified and would love to love her to know she is simply amazing!
Definitely recommend visiting this store!

I had an amazing experience with the hair and makeup artists at Mecca Castle Towers ! Devi and Tamana did a fantabulous job, and I couldn't be happier with the results. A special shoutout to the person who looked after me when I arrived -the lovely and welcoming Keira .She went above and beyond to accommodate my request for an early start, ensuring that I wasn't late for my event. The service was outstanding, and they made me feel so comfortable throughout the whole process. Highly recommend their team for any occasion!
Thank you Devi,Keira and Tamana for the amazing service!!! You guys rock and make a great team!! Thank you once again.I received lots of compliments about my make up and hair
Tamsyn, was extremely helpful with her service. She was professional polite and very informative. She definitely knows her Mecca products.

Recently purchased my new favourite lipstick with the help of Caitlin who was so helpful and lovely. Caitlin wasn’t pushy, just genuinely helpful and patient in choosing a lipstick with the little information that I gave her and not really knowing exactly what I was after. Epitome of an excellent salesperson and after working through a few (see pic!) I ended up with a product that I completely love. 💄 😍

Today I had the most amazing experience at Mecca, made my day. The staff that helped me today was so thorough in choosing a perfume as a present for my cousins bridal shower. I forgot to ask for her name but I ended up choosing ‘on a date’ by replica. I hope she finds this, thank you so much again. :))

I would like to say a big thank you to one of the staff Nicola. She always serve me and my two daughters with love and respect. I hope she enjoys the flowers my daughters brought her due to the amazing customer service.

Ebony C was so helpful and explained everything so thoroughly I went from being unsure what products to purchase or what would suit my face to buying everything she recommended. Thank you for being so lovely and wonderful, it's made all the difference.

My recent visit to Sephora Parramatta left me feeling extremely disappointed and frustrated with the level of customer service I received. I had gone into the store with the intention of purchasing a lipstick, but unfortunately, the entire experience turned sour.

Upon approaching a staff member, I shared my preference for a specific lipstick color. However, despite explicitly stating my choice, I was given a completely different shade. It was evident that the color was wrong, and I trusted the staff member's expertise without checking the box myself. This lack of attention to detail was disheartening and left me feeling deceived.

When I returned home and eagerly tried the lipstick, I was appalled to find that the color was nothing like what I had requested. The shade turned out to be completely unsuitable for my preferences, and I was left with a product I could not use.

Seeking a resolution, I visited Sephora Parramatta the following day to exchange the opened lipstick for the correct color. However, I was met with disappointment yet again. A staff member named Nadia informed me of a new policy stating that opened lipsticks could no longer be exchanged. Frustrated by this sudden change, I requested to speak to the manager, hoping for a more reasonable solution.

To my surprise, Nadia claimed to be the manager and firmly stated that she could not authorize the exchange. This response was disheartening and made me question the professionalism and customer-centric approach within Sephora Parramatta.

As a result, I decided to dispose of the lipstick in the rubbish bin, feeling utterly let down by the entire experience. It is essential for Sephora Parramatta to reevaluate their exchange policy, particularly when it comes to opened beauty products. Such inflexible policies do not align with providing excellent customer service.

Furthermore, it is crucial for the staff to undergo proper training to ensure that customers receive the correct products and that their concerns are addressed in a satisfactory manner. Trust and confidence in the staff's ability to fulfill customers' needs are paramount to fostering a positive shopping experience.

I sincerely hope that Sephora Parramatta takes this feedback constructively and works towards implementing changes that prioritize customer satisfaction. As a loyal customer, I believe in the potential for improvement and look forward to a more positive experience in the future.

Unfortunately I'm a little inclined to agree that the recent flood of positive reviews might be botted/scripted... the store beforehand had around 35 (averaging ~3.8/5 stars), and then right before it renovates (not even after it'd opened!), it jumps up to 500 with a 4.9? More reviews than most, if not all, stores in Westfield Parramatta? Common sense suggests it might not be legitimate, but I'd love to be proven wrong.

That aside, I stopped by this Monday to buy something, and when I got to the counter I asked if they had change for a $50 note, and I was told no- they didn't do cash exchanges. I then asked if I had to pay in the exact cash amount, to which I was told that I didn't have to and could pay with my $50? Turns out the cashier thought I meant that I just wanted to exchange my cash, but surely it was obvious that I was trying to buy something, because I was at the counter with items in my hand... despite being the only person at the counter it took a bit of a while for them to scan my item and print a receipt? Usually not a big issue for me, but I just thought it was a little weird seeing everything else that had already happened. Usually service in other branches are much faster, esp. the Chatswood one imo.

Also, the item I bought was covered in a fine layer of black-grey dust on the packaging. It didn't affect the product, just the packaging, but I was wondering if, well, anyone ever cleaned up the products on the shelves? This probably isn't helped by the aisles being very, very narrow- two people can barely pass each other, leading to people stepping over each other and getting trapped in aisles! I will admit that the new layout looks more modern, but seems to have only resulted in a lot of issues movement-wise because they've kind of crammed all their products into a small portion of their store and left other parts completely blank.

For me, I might just stick to the Chatswood W Cosmetics, which I've found is better with its tester availability (and cleanliness), store layout, and staff there are friendlier in my opinion.
